partnershipPlan: Two patient partners review the plain-language summary and the wording of any recoding letter; practice pharmacists review the discordance categories before analysis.
socialListening: No social media listening; practice complaints about unexpected kidney disease labels in the last two years are read without identifiers.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My blood tests had been low for years and nobody mentioned my kidneys until a new doctor looked.
items.implication: Report sensitivity by age band and make missed reviews the main harm described.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I had a stomach bug, one blood test was low, and now I am on a kidney list and my tablets were changed.
items.implication: Quantify codes resting on a single low result during acute illness.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If the search throws up four hundred names, somebody has to look at each one before we code it.
items.implication: Measure positive predictive value before any automated recoding.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The dose checks only fire when the code is there; without it, the system thinks the kidneys are fine.
items.implication: Link missed codes to the dose checks they switch off in the discussion.

summary: Four composite voices on missed diagnoses, false labels, workload and medicine safety.
